subject: varying intercept and slope in GLMM using R-INLA

messages.author: 87da44a4763ea902
messages.subject: varying intercept and slope in GLMM using R-INLA
parts:
Hi INLA group and Rue,

Thanks for recommending the great paper "Bayesian varying coefficient models using PC priors" in the previous discussion. I have downloaded this pdf through arXiv, but I can not find the supplementary material regarding INLA code even though the authors say yes in the paper. Would you please send the code or show how to get it?  

Another question: When I intend to conduct a varying intercept and slope mixed model using INLA, I find two ways from this discussion group: (1) using the "iid2d and copy", e.g. formula= y~A+f(B, model="iid2d", n=2*length(B))+f(B1, A, copy="B"), (2) directly y~A+f(B,model="iid")+f(B1, A, model="iid"). I want to know whether both ways are equal and give the same results? or some differences exist? which way should I use? 

Thanks very much!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] varying intercept and slope in GLMM using R-INLA
parts:
the iid2d implements a bivariate with dependence, while two iid would
be independent.

there is also the model 'intslope' that is a simplified interface to
the a+b*x model where (a,b) are iid2d

H
